title: Agent folders
footer: Sessions working in these folders on the selected computer, with any Agent. Block: that computer stops collecting them, so nothing in Persona shows or counts them, and their permission requests are left to the agent's own interface. Hide: they stay recorded but leave Agents and Persona's view; active supervised Persona tasks stay visible. A path covers that folder and everything in it; ~ is that computer's home; *name* matches a folder name anywhere. Switch a rule off to show its sessions again. To stop collecting a Claude Code config folder altogether, use Blocked config directories under Claude Code.
empty: No Agent folder rules on this computer.
failed: Could not save or load rules: {error}
temporary_view: Temporary view only. Assistant visibility and rules stay unchanged.
pattern_prefix: Start with / or ~/ (~ is that computer's home), or * for a folder name
pattern_root: Can't use the whole home or root folder
